request.subject: UNIT:UNDEAD:GUARD

layers.text: Change only two things: his skin (face, ears, both arms) becomes pallid light warm ash grey with no blue at all, shaded darker grey; and his two eyes become small glowing bright violet eyes instead of yellow-green. Keep everything else exactly the same: the dark hair, the bone necklace, the charcoal smock with its violet hem, the bandaged hands, the feet, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style, on a transparent background.
